one_line: Major model releases, industry AI deployments, and new research benchmarks marked today's AI landscape.

themes.title: New frontier AI models released
themes.text: Mistral AI previewed its 1‑trillion‑parameter Mistral Large 4 multimodal model and launched the Voxtral 3 voice SDK. Anthropic introduced Claude Duet, a proactive AI agent, while OpenAI announced that its GPT‑6 and GPT‑6.1 models will be available on Google Cloud for select enterprise customers.

stories.headline: Mistral AI opens preview of Mistral Large 4, a 1‑trillion‑parameter multimodal model
Mistral AI releases Voxtral 3 voice agent SDK with multilingual speech models
Anthropic launches Claude Duet AI agent in research preview
OpenAI’s GPT‑6, 6.1 models to be available on Google Cloud

themes.title: AI expands into commerce and finance
themes.text: Walmart will let external AI agents shop for customers via its new Agent Gateway, while fintech startup Karta AI raised $3 million to automate complex inbound banking calls. DeepSeek secured roughly $15 billion in funding, highlighting continued investment in AI despite recent U.S. restrictions.

stories.headline: Walmart to let AI agents shop for customers via new Agent Gateway
Karta AI raises $3 million seed round to automate complex inbound banking calls
DeepSeek raises about $15 billion in funding round days after US restrictions

themes.title: Research advances in multimodal agents
themes.text: Researchers benchmarked six frontier models on the LIBERO‑10 robot manipulation suite, with GPT‑6 Astra achieving a 44 % success rate. A new PAPAV framework was proposed to unify multimodal agents and robots, and the Environment Duels benchmark studied LLM co‑evolution in author‑solver interactions. Microsoft researchers used a human‑directed AI process to prove the 31‑year‑old KLS conjecture in high‑dimensional geometry.
